title: Pure Regenesis
summary: Regenesis cards only, with generic staples; the page's Kashtira, Bystial and Dogmatika engines are left out. Every Regenesis monster has 2500 ATK and DEF, so one summons the next from the hand. Regenesis Archfiend reveals another to summon itself and searches Regenesis Lord, which banishes it to set Regenesis Birth from the Deck. Regenesis Sage negates by sending a spare Regenesis card, and the monsters sent that turn return to the hand in the opponent's End Phase. Regenesis Overlord, the newest card, comes back from the GY by banishing two of them and bounces a card for each banished one. Regenesis Cycle and Regenesis Commands are not out in the TCG yet. The Xyz Monsters are generic Rank 7s and 8s.
